summary: Ventas, Inc. disclosed that EVP, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary Carey S. Roberts will resign effective June 26, 2026 to join Blackstone as Senior Managing Director and General Counsel - Real Estate. Kevin M. Bohl, SVP & Deputy General Counsel, will assume her duties on an interim basis. The board expressed gratitude for Roberts' contributions. No compensatory arrangements or financial terms were provided. The change is voluntary and not abrupt, but it is the core event triggering the filing. Investors should watch for identification of a permanent replacement and any impact on ongoing litigation or regulatory matters.
